confidence_notes: Holistic estimates based on typical Muscat pricing; July heat may lower hotel demand, and the limited hostel supply makes lodging anchors less certain. Cocktail and wine estimates use their usual licensed-hotel-bar price relationship to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Muscat's position as a Gulf capital with lower everyday costs than Dubai or Doha, while accounting for imported alcohol and a hot-season lodging lull.
